image_description: A close-up, high-resolution image of a green snake's head resting on a tree branch. The snake has vivid green scales with some yellowish tinting near the snout and jaw. The eye is large, dark, and round with a visible reflection. The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), emphasizing the subject.

It resembles a generic colubrid or viper head more than the specific elapid profile described.

artifact_observations.location: Snake scales on the top of the head
artifact_observations.reasoning: The scales on the crown of the head appear slightly 'mushy' or fused together compared to the crisp definition on the cheek. The transition between individual scales lacks the sharp, distinct edges seen in macro photography of real snakes, suggesting slight AI smoothing.

The anatomical structure of the snout is somewhat ambiguous. The way the yellow scales blend into the green lacks clear structural definition, appearing slightly like melted wax rather than distinct keratinous plates.
